data.content:
A victory against Augsburg would offer a timely response to the criticism and could take Leipzig level on points with Bayern and Borussia Dortmund, although Demichelis will need to manage several fitness concerns ahead of the contest.

Antonio Nusa is a doubt after being withdrawn against Manchester City as a precaution, while Marc Guiu remains sidelined with a hamstring problem, and Max Finkgrafe and Assan Ouedraogo are also struggling with injuries. [...] Nevertheless, Baum will have to reorganise his defence, with Noahkai Banks unavailable through injury, Calvin Brackelmann recovering from concussion and Abdulai Juma Bah suspended, leaving Jeffrey Gouweleeuw, Yannik Keitel and Chrislain Matsima as potential defensive starters.
